story_position: Chapter 3 — Beat 4 — The Seal That Wasn't Used
scene_purpose: Examine the real royal seal and its custody under normal Crown procedure; kill the obvious explanations without solving the mechanism; identify Nimera Pellan as the next useful Card expert; split the investigation between the Crown-side and Old City tracks.

sections: Beat 4 — The Seal That Wasn't Used

scene_context_seed.location_name: Caelora palace restricted royal verification / seal-custody room
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Normal secure Crown procedure under abnormal circumstances. The room and records may carry evidence without every participant being assigned a line. Portraits + dialogue box; minimal physical staging.

hard_outcomes: The actual physical royal seal is produced under normal custody procedure, is present and intact, and still answers normally for Lysara.
A legitimate comparison and the suspect Card-transport order produce the same recognized core royal magical authority response, leaving ordinary visual forgery inadequate.
Custody/access records reveal no simple documented theft-and-return window, while the scene does not treat the records as infallible or proximity as guilt.
Unauthorized physical access and an unknown nonstandard magical means both remain possible in broad terms; neither is proven or selected as the answer.
The physical seal remains secured in the palace and the Card is not used in any experiment.
Nimera Pellan is identified as the next useful Card expert in the Old City archives.
Only bounded authenticated comparison material is permitted to travel to Nimera.
Maevra stays in Caelora with Mirena on the Crown-side investigation; Cyanis, Ilyra, and Torren receive lawful Old City access and go to find Nimera.
